# MIT licence for the settings metadata and the panel files

This repository is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0, see `LICENSE`.

Three files are, in addition, available under the MIT licence below, so that other Smart Parks
software with an MIT licence (Smart Parks Protect) can use the same setting names, guided
panels and rules as this app:

- `settings-meta.json`
- `panels/panel-definitions.js`
- `panels/panel-engine.js`

You may use these three files under either licence. Everything else in this repository,
including `panels/panel-renderer.js` and the device icons in `device-icons.js`, stays under the
GPL-3.0 alone.
